definition: Computer systems designed to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
A branch of artificial intelligence in which systems learn patterns from data.
The practice of designing instructions that guide an AI model toward a desired output.
Using software to perform repeatable tasks with reduced manual intervention.
Large Language Model, an AI model trained to process and generate human language.
The process through which a trained AI model generates an output from an input.
An Application Programming Interface that allows software systems to communicate.
A unit of text processed by many language models.
A numerical representation of information used by AI systems to measure relationships and similarity.
Additional training of an existing AI model on a specialized dataset.
